subject: Buyer map + next steps for DataForge pilot intake
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Buyer map + next steps for DataForge pilot

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: DataForge wants to trial a latency-sensitive inference flow for your summarization pipeline (indices + prompt templates). You mentioned a 6–8 week pilot to validate latency and cost at production-ish traffic.
- Key open: we need confirmation of the budget owner / economic buyer and the procurement timeline for a sub-$100k pilot. You flagged Lina Park and procurement as likely gatekeepers.

Action items I can take this week:
1) Share a short SOW and pricing band for the pilot (attached: Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf).
2) Send a concise checklist for your procurement team outlining security artifacts and expected SLAs (attached: Redwood_Security_Requirements_OnePager.pdf).
3) Coordinate a 30-min alignment call with Lina / procurement to confirm PO timing and billing cadence.

Could you confirm: who is the final signatory on pilot spend (PO or charge card)? And is Michael Tan on the procurement side the right contact to loop in? If helpful, I can draft the intro email you can forward to Lina and Michael.

Calendar: proposing Mon/Tue next week — I included a few slots here: https://cal.com/ben-redwood/30 (open to whatever works on your side).

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf; Redwood_Security_Requirements_OnePager.pdf
From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@dataforge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@dataforge.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Buyer map + next steps for DataForge pilot

Thanks Ben — great recap. A couple quick notes:

> Ben Carter wrote:
> > Key open: we need confirmation of the budget owner / economic buyer and the procurement timeline for a sub-$100k pilot.

- Lina is VP Product and is the most likely budget owner for this pilot; she will want a short business case (impact to TTR and infra savings) and to see expected SLAs. I’ve CC'd her.
- Michael Tan is our procurement lead for third-party pilots; he reviews SOWs and approves POs. He is out of office until Tuesday but I’ll loop him in once he’s back. For now, Lina can greenlight the costs and schedule the PO.

Procurement timeline (approx):
- Tue (14th): Michael back, initial intake
- Wed–Thu: procurement review (security checklist + SOW)
- Fri: tentative PO approval if no red flags

I’ll route the SOW to Michael when he’s back. For the business case, can you provide a 1-pager with expected token cost at projected volume and the key metrics we’ll measure during the pilot?

Also — can you confirm whether Redwood requires any platform-level access for the pilot or if data will only be sent via API? We want to pre-check our security team.

Best,
Sarah
Head of ML Platform, DataForge
sarah.cole@dataforge.ai

Ben / Laura — drafting a short buyer outreach that Ben can send to Lina + Michael once Sarah confirms Michael is back. I attached a 1-page business-case template tailored to DataForge use-case (DataForge_Eval-Brief.docx).

Suggested send strategy:
- Send Ben’s intro + SOW to Lina (TO) and Michael (CC) with Sarah copied. Keep the ask simple: confirm budget ownership, confirm PO path or card payment, and request a 30-min intake call to close timeline.
- Include the 1-pager (impact & expected cost ranges) and our security one-pager.

Draft outreach (short):
---
Hi Lina + Michael —
Thanks for taking a look. Per our call with Sarah, Redwood proposes a 6-week pilot to validate latency and cost at production-like traffic. Attached is a short SOW and a 1-pager with estimated spend ranges and pilot metrics. Can we set 30 minutes Tue/Wed to confirm PO timing and any security questions?
Best — Ben Carter
---

If we get a greenlight from Lina we should propose auto-invoice/PO options (PO preferred for enterprise). Laura — can you confirm our shortest billing cadence for a pilot (30 days invoice?) and any standard procurement docs we should attach?

Monica

Subject: Intro + SOW: Redwood pilot proposal for DataForge (quick alignment)

Hi Lina / Michael — I’m Ben from Redwood Inference; Sarah suggested I reach out to align on a short production-style pilot we discussed. I’ve attached a concise SOW and a one-page business brief that summarizes expected metrics and ballpark spend.

Quick asks to confirm intake:
- Who is the final signatory for pilot spend? (PO or card)
- Can procurement confirm the expected timing for PO issuance if we proceed this week?
- Any mandatory security artifacts we should surface now (SOC2, SSAE, data retention labels)? Monica has attached our security one-pager for ease.

If it helps, here are 2 slots for a 30-min intake call: Tue 9/15 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 9/16 14:00–14:30 PT. Otherwise, please propose a time.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best regards,
